Name: Pollen Puff
Effect: Projectile Move. Or Target the Target. When this move is used against the Target, it will heal 2 HP instead of damage, Spend 1 Will Point to get this effect.
Description: The Pokémon creates a puff of pollen that explodes on the foe's face and gives them a terrible allergy. When consumed, these puffs are sweet and very nutritious.
